🥗 Official Regime Foods & Notes
Foods: Tuna, Yogurt and fruit, Peanut butter sandwich, Chocolate milk & pretzels, Smoothies, Turkey whole-grain, Whole grains, Eggs, Chicken, Salmon, Venison.

Vitamins: Vitamin D3, C, Zinc, Magnesium, E, B6, B12, Folate, A.

Supplement Stack: Whey, Creatine, Amino Acids, Carbs, HMB, Glutamine, L-Carnitine, L-Arginine.
💊 1. Core Performance Matrix
This matrix contrasts standard high-performing dessert-style proteins and performance pre-workouts against estimated costs and specific functional metrics:

• Protein Option A (GHOST Whey): Standout Flavors: Cinnabon, Oreo, Marshmallow Cereal Milk. Active Core: 0mg caffeine (Whey Blend + Digestive Enzymes for enhanced absorption). Est. Cost: \$1.45–\$1.60 per serving.
• Protein Option B (RYSE Loaded): Standout Flavors: Jet-Puffed Marshmallow, Cosmic Brownie. Active Core: 0mg caffeine (Whey Isolate/Concentrate blend). Est. Cost: \$1.30–\$1.50 per serving.
• Pre-Workout Option A (Alani Nu): Cosmic Stardust, Hawaiian Shaved Ice. 200mg Caffeine + L-Theanine. \$1.10–\$1.30.
• Pre-Workout Option B (Gorilla Mode): Bombsicle, Watermelon, White Gummy Bear. 400mg Caffeine + L-Citrulline. \$1.80–\$2.00.
💊 2. Foundational Muscle-Building Additions
Beyond premium proteins and performance stimulants, clinical research validates specific core supplements to enhance lean tissue adaptation, muscular power, and biological recovery:

• Creatine Monohydrate: The industry gold standard for cellular energy replication. Safely supersaturates cellular phosphocreatine stores for power output & workload capacity. Dose: 5g daily, unflavored.
• Omega-3 Fatty Acids (Fish Oil): Essential biological anti-inflammatory agent. Accelerates protein synthesis and lowers post-exercise soreness. Dose: 1,000mg–2,000mg EPA/DHA daily.
• Vitamin D3 & K2 Co-Factors: Essential hormonal base layer. Optimizes natural serum testosterone production, improves acute muscular power, and supports systemic skeletal infrastructure. Dose: 2,000–5,000 IU D3 + 100mcg K2.
• Magnesium Bisglycinate: Foundation of musculoskeletal relaxation. Regulates deep somatic sleep and maximizes growth hormone secretion. Dose: 200mg–400mg 30–60 mins pre-sleep.
🚫 3. Market Formulations to Exclude
To optimize nutritional efficiency and financial expenditure, the following marketing-heavy categories should be avoided:

• Branched-Chain Amino Acids (BCAAs): Redundant when daily whole-food or whey protein intakes are met, as premium whey blends natively maximize leucine, isoleucine, and valine targets.
• Commercial Mass Gainers: Predominantly comprised of cheap maltodextrin carbohydrates and artificial texturizers that introduce excessive glycemic loads, risking unintended visceral fat accumulation.
• Over-the-Counter Testosterone Boosters: Lacking valid medical or clinical evidence backing long-term muscle hypertrophy. Prioritize structural sleep architecture and micronutrient optimization instead.
⏰ 4. Daily Chrono-Nutrient Supplement Schedule
This template maps specific intake windows to exploit metabolic demands, digestive transit times, and circadian rhythms for peak performance and deep tissue recovery:

• Morning (With First Meal): Vitamin D3 & K2 (2,000-5,000 IU / 100mcg) + Omega-3 Fish Oil (1,000-2,000mg EPA/DHA). Rationale: Fat-soluble vitamins achieve maximum bioavailability when paired with dietary lipids during breakfast.
• Pre-Workout (30-45 Min Prior): Pre-Workout Option A or B (1 Rounded Scoop in 8-12 oz Cold Water). Rationale: Allows peak serum levels of caffeine and active vasodilators to match heavy muscular exertion.
• Post-Workout (Within 0-2 Hours): Whey Protein Option A or B (1-2 Scoops, 25-50g protein) + Creatine Monohydrate (5g pure/unflavored). Rationale: Supplies raw substrate to initiate muscle protein synthesis; creatine absorption is enhanced via post-exercise insulin sensitivity.
• Evening/Night (30-60 Min Pre-Sleep): Magnesium Bisglycinate (200mg-400mg). Rationale: Triggers systemic muscle relaxation, down-regulates CNS stimulation, and optimizes REM/deep sleep architecture.
